execution_difference: Rounded-down remaining quantity cap; full exit if either side of partial reduction violates native minimum stake or conversion leaves excess. Shared by all three futures accounts; no spot result replacement.
decision_rule: Same frozen model on observed continuous L window. Preserve all outcomes; no retuning after S losses. Compare F1 to cash and separately BTC, F2 to same-profile control. No reset-fold or independent-OOS claim from continuous slices; original complete qualification remains required.
assumptions: Official core unchanged. Costs 8/15bps each side charged once through native fee field, plus native funding model.
5m futures mark OPEN valuations with remaining exit-cost reserve, before each native event.
Funding rates use pinned 1h-rate files joined to 1h marks, with official inclusive intervals reset at fills. This does not prove real settlement/fill ordering.
Native Binance configuration uses the preexisting public orderbook-validation fix; no historical depth is inferred.
5-second risk monitoring, 60-second cancellation, historical rules/receipt time, executable spread and capacity are not certified.
Daily scaling starts 00:05; native candle fill assumptions and same-timestamp pair sequence retained.
Final model NAV at last 23:55 pre-event observation; artificial terminal native close reported separately.
No comparisons pooling spot V1 routing and futures minimum-routing into a global winner.
